summary.text: Alyssa Black is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-24 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a healthcare administrator who lives in Essex.

paragraphs.text: Alyssa Black was born in Fredonia, New York, and lives in Essex, Vermont.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont, and her career experience includes working as a healthcare administrator.
Black's current term began on January 4, 2023, and she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
She served on the House Health Care Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
